notes: Bootstrap mode is intentionally narrow: only exploratory work with a decisive deterministic oracle may complete directly.
Standard-risk direct completion requires a local calibrated evidence file that clears conservative confidence bounds; seed worker priors never authorize gateway expansion.
The gateway remains a semantic classifier, so this policy script is a fail-closed second check rather than proof that the task was classified correctly.
High and critical work never completes directly at the gateway.
If calibration is missing, malformed, sparse, or worse than rollback thresholds, escalate to the authority parent.
